en.headline: Woman loses HK$349,000 in jewellery and cash after Yuen Long village house burglary
en.dek: A 68-year-old resident of a Fairview Park house on Pinery Road South reported a door prised open late on Sunday, with watches, gold and cash missing; police have classified the case as burglary.
body: Police received a report at about 11pm on Sunday from a 68-year-old woman surnamed Hau living in a village house on Pinery Road South in Fairview Park, Yuen Long.
She told officers she had found a door prised open and signs of searching inside the property, and suspected a burglary.
Preliminary checks indicated that items worth about HK$349,000 were missing, including two watches, two gold grains, two necklaces, and both Hong Kong dollar and foreign currency cash.
The case has been classified as burglary and handed to the Yuen Long District Crime Unit Team 8 for investigation. No arrests have been made so far.
Correction: A character error in the Chinese version has been fixed.

zh.headline: 元朗錦繡花園村屋遭爆竊 68歲女戶主失約34.9萬元財物
zh.dek: 周日晚上約11時，松濤南路一間村屋68歲侯姓女住戶報案指門被撬開，屋內有搜掠痕跡，失物包括手錶、金粒、頸鏈及現金，警方列爆竊案跟進。
body: 警方周日晚上約11時接獲元朗錦繡花園松濤南路一間村屋68歲侯姓女住戶報案。
她表示發現家中一扇門被撬開，屋內有搜掠痕跡，懷疑遭爆竊。
初步點算相信失物總值約34.9萬元，包括兩隻手錶、兩粒金粒、兩條頸鏈，以及港幣及外幣現金。
案件列作爆竊，交由元朗警區刑事調查隊第八隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
更正：先前版本中文用字有誤，已修正為「撬」。
